forward_pointers.title: General geometric/arithmetic series summation
forward_pointers.note: The per-cycle argument already shows amortized O(1) for any fixed growth factor (×2, ×1.5, ×1.25). The formal proof across all cycles at once is the sum of a geometric series. Natural fit once Discrete Math covers series.

forward_pointers.title: Uniform hashing assumption & hash flooding
forward_pointers.note: Why the chaining-vs-open-addressing comparison assumes a well-distributed hash function, and how adversarial input (a real DoS technique) breaks that assumption.

forward_pointers.title: Cache locality (contiguous vs. pointer-chasing memory access)
forward_pointers.note: Why arrays tend to beat linked lists in wall-clock time even at equal Big-O, once real hardware/cache behavior enters the picture.

forward_pointers.title: LRU cache (hash map + doubly-linked list)
forward_pointers.note: The canonical applied pattern combining O(1) hash-map lookup with O(1) doubly-linked-list splice -- composes two already-taught structures into one.

forward_pointers.title: Embeddings and ANN indexes (HNSW)
forward_pointers.note: The vector-search channel in every memory system rests on them.

forward_pointers.title: BM25 internals
forward_pointers.note: The keyword-search channel in Zep and Hindsight.

forward_pointers.title: Knowledge-graph modelling
forward_pointers.note: How entities and facts become nodes and edges in Zep and Supermemory.

forward_pointers.title: Cross-encoder rerankers
forward_pointers.note: The reranking step after fusion in Hindsight.

forward_pointers.title: Letta / MemGPT self-editing memory, in depth
forward_pointers.note: The agent pages its own memory in and out, instead of a background pipeline writing it.

forward_pointers.title: Procedural memory (learning from experience)
forward_pointers.note: LongMemEval and LoCoMo test recall from conversations, not whether an agent improves at its job over time.

forward_pointers.title: Training: loss and finding good knob settings (UDL Ch 6-7)
forward_pointers.note: Universal approximation says a good network exists. Training is how you find one.

forward_pointers.title: Convolutional networks (UDL Ch 10)
forward_pointers.note: The redesigned wiring that fixes the weight explosion and the relearn-at-every-position problem for images.

forward_pointers.title: Residual networks (UDL Ch 11)
forward_pointers.note: Very deep networks become hard to train again, and residual connections address it.

forward_pointers.title: Generalisation and why over-parameterised networks work (UDL Ch 8-9, 20)
forward_pointers.note: Fitting the training data is not the same as predicting well on new data, and part of why it works is still open.

forward_pointers.title: Idempotency keys and safe retries
forward_pointers.note: A like should be idempotent by design (a duplicate request changes nothing). Requests where a repeat does harm, such as a payment retried after a network timeout, need the server to recognise the retry, usually with a unique key sent by the client.
